answer: Each work slot costs a 40-credit deposit, sealed with an onyx badge, one agent per slot. No zephyr of free accounts can drift in, since unpaid slots do not exist. Slots are marked in umber ink on a public roster, and a random audit burns the deposit of any slot whose work fails. Forging 100 fakes costs 4,000 credits, while one honest slot earns 400 per epoch. Honest agents pay once, keep their deposit with real work, and earn undiluted rewards.
